newsitem.title: CHINA: China acrylic fibre imports seen 300,000 T in '97.
newsitem.headline: China acrylic fibre imports seen 300,000 T in '97.

text.p: China was forecast to import 300,000 tonnes of acrylic fibre in 1997, the Market Daily said on Wednesday.
Domestic production would remain at the 1996 level of about 320,000 tonnes, the newspaper said.
Domestic demand for acrylic fibre this year was between 500,000 and 540,000 tonnes, it said.
China would have a glut of acrylic fibre this year due to strong levels of imports and existing stockpiles of about 250,000-300,000 tonnes, it said.
China's imports for acrylic fibre exceeded 400,000 tonnes in 1996 while domestic consumption last year was about 500,000 tonnes, it said.
